title: The Warm Delivery
premise_public: A courier arrived with a sealed package in perfect condition. After noticing it was warm, she refused to hand it over. The recipient thanked her.
solution_summary: The parcel contained medication requiring refrigerated transport. Its warmth showed the cold chain had failed, so delivering it as usable medication would be unsafe.

facts.text: The seal was intact but its temperature was too high.
The contents could no longer be trusted to remain safe or effective.
The recipient understood why it must be rejected.
The package had not been deliberately tampered with.

acceptable_solutions: The package contained temperature-sensitive medicine that warmed during transport.
It was medication needing refrigeration; the broken cold chain made it unsafe.
The sealed delivery was too warm for the refrigerated drugs inside.
hints: An intact seal does not guarantee usable contents.
Some deliveries must remain within a narrow temperature range.
